title: What Is Alive?
summary: The seven life processes (MRS GREN) that every living thing shows, and why a car or a fire is not alive.

ib.note: Cells as the unit of life follow in Unit 2

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 10: Living Creatures: Exploring their Characteristics

objectives: I can list the seven characteristics of living things (MRS GREN).
I can use them to decide whether something is living or non-living.
I can explain why some non-living things show a few of these characteristics.
misconceptions: Plants are not alive because they don't move.
